title: Perjury Machine
style: Early 90s EBM, 126 BPM, pulsing sequenced bass, hard machine drums, noisy synth stabs, filtered courtroom and press-conference voice samples, sci-fi radio transmissions, growled heavily processed male vocal, defiant cyberpunk war dancefloor energy
negativeTags: pop, country, acoustic, happy, ballad, chiptune, synthwave
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Spoken sample, filtered courtroom voice: "Order! The witness will answer the question!"]
[Spoken sample, shouted prosecutor: "I want the truth, and I want it now!"]

[Verse]
Hand on the book
Tongue made of wire
Promise in daylight
Sold by the hour

[Pre-Chorus]
Flashbulbs burning
Cameras roll
Every word rehearsed
Every word is sold

[Chorus]
Perjury machine
Smiling on the screen
Swear it on the wire
Every vote's for hire
Perjury machine
Truth was never clean

[Breakdown]
[Spoken sample, filtered press-conference voice: "I have no recollection of those events."]
[Spoken sample, shouted judge: "Answer me! Did you lie?"]
(Growled) Liar, liar
Liar, liar

[Chorus]
Perjury machine
Smiling on the screen
Swear it on the wire
Every vote's for hire

[Outro]
[Spoken sample, radio static: "No further questions."]
Perjury machine
